name: quorum
description: Claude Code plugin for second opinions from a panel of LLMs via OpenRouter.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API Key
openrouter_api_key.description: Get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys. Leave blank if you already have OPENROUTER_API_KEY in your environment or a key file at ~/.config/openrouter/key — the server falls back to those.

panel_models.title: Panel models
panel_models.description: Comma-separated families or slugs queried in parallel by /quorum:ask. Family names resolve via OpenRouter's ~latest aliases.

require_no_logging.title: Require no-logging providers
require_no_logging.description: When on, every request asks OpenRouter to only route to inference providers that don't log or train on prompts. On by default. Turn off if you've added a model whose only available provider trains on data.
